newsitem.title: USA: Intl Multifoods financial officer leaves.
newsitem.headline: Intl Multifoods financial officer leaves.

text.p: International Multifoods Corp said Friday that Duncan Cocroft, vice president-finance and chief financial officer, is leaving the company to pursue other interests.
Robert Price, chairman and chief executive officer, said a search for a successor to Cocroft is under way.

"One of my top priorities is to build a strong management team that can help Multifoods deliver superior financial performance and create value for all its stakeholders," Gary Costley, chairman, president and chief executive officer-elect, said in a statement. "With the departure of Duncan Cocroft, the addition of a new CFO will be an important step in achieving this objective."
Until a new CFO is chosen, executives heading the company's financial reporting, treasury, investor relations and audit functions will report to the CEO.
Robert Wright, president of the bakery segment, will assume responsibility for the company's food exporting business.
Multifoods operates in three businesses -- foodservice distribution in the United States, bakery products in the United States and Canada, and bakery, consumer and agricultural products in Venezuela.
